analytics.assetsEmpty: No asset completed a run in this window
analytics.assetsSubtitle: Select an asset to narrow the figures above to it

analytics.empty: No runs completed in this window

analytics.noBreaks: No abandoned attempts in this window.
analytics.noSegments: No stops or legs to show
analytics.trendEmpty: No runs completed in this window

asset.empty: No journeys you can see are assigned to this asset

assetType.title: Journeys

assign.assetTypes: Asset types (every asset of the type)

assign.noAssets: No assets you can edit match.

assign.title: Assign {{name}}

assignments.removeAssetBody: Tracking stops for this asset unless its asset type is assigned too. Runs already recorded are kept.
assignments.removeTypeBody: Tracking stops for every asset of this type that isn’t assigned some other way. Runs already recorded are kept.

board.disabled: This journey is disabled. Enable it to see where its assets are on the route.
board.noneOnRoute: Assigned, but no asset is on the route right now.
board.originNote: Waiting between runs. Time here is turnaround before the next run starts.
board.pick: Select a stop or a leg to see the assets there.
board.unassignedBody: Assign assets or asset types to this journey; they appear here as they report.
board.untrackable: A stop is at a circle place, which isn’t tracked yet, so this journey won’t record runs or show assets here.

OUT_OF_ORDER.explanation: Arrived at a stop of this route that was neither the next one nor the one just left.
OUT_OF_ORDER.label: Out of order

RETURNED_TO_ORIGIN.explanation: Came back to the first stop before reaching the second. This is turnaround, not a broken run, so it is left out of the headline count.
RETURNED_TO_ORIGIN.label: False start

TIMED_OUT.explanation: Did not finish the route within the longest run allowed after leaving the first stop.
TIMED_OUT.label: Took too long

builder.addStopAfter: Add a stop after the selected one
builder.arrivalDwellHelp: An asset must stay this long at a stop to count as having arrived. Shorter than that, it was passing through.

builder.created: Journey created. Assign it to assets or asset types to start recording runs.
builder.departureGapHelp: An asset must be away this long to count as having left. Shorter than that, it never left.
builder.discardBody: It hasn’t been saved. Leaving now throws the route away.

builder.limitCycle: Give up on a run that takes too long
builder.localInvalid_one: Fix the highlighted issue before saving.

builder.loopHelp: Don’t add the first stop again at the end — the leg back to it is drawn for you.
builder.maxCycleHelp: A run still in progress after this long is given up and counted as timed out.
builder.name: Journey name
builder.noPlaces: There are no places here yet. Create the places this route stops at first.

copy.body_other: Duplicated from {{name}}, which has {{count}} assignments. Assignments aren’t copied automatically.
copy.partial_one: {{count}} assignment could not be copied — a deleted asset, or one you can’t edit.
copy.partial_other: {{count}} assignments could not be copied — deleted assets, or ones you can’t edit.

detail.discardBody: The new name or description hasn’t been saved. Leaving now throws it away.
detail.editSubtitle: The route and its timings stay as they are. To change them, duplicate the journey.
detail.enabledHelp: Disabling stops tracking and keeps history; enabling starts tracking afresh.
detail.notFound: This journey no longer exists, or you no longer have access to it.

enableFailed.body: Its route no longer checks out. A route can’t be edited, so duplicate the journey as a new one over places that still exist.
enableFailed.title: Couldn’t enable {{name}}

errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: The server took too long to answer. Try a shorter date range.
errors.JOURNEY_ASSIGNMENT_EXISTS: The journey is already assigned to that.
errors.JOURNEY_ASSIGNMENT_TARGET_NOT_FOUND: That asset or asset type can’t be found here, or it belongs to another organization.
errors.JOURNEY_ASSIGNMENT_TARGET_REFUSED: You can see that asset but not edit it, and assigning a journey to an asset needs edit access.
errors.JOURNEY_INVALID_NODE: Describe the place either as a location or as a circle on the map, not both.
errors.JOURNEY_INVALID_WINDOW: That date range is too long or ends before it starts.
errors.JOURNEY_NODE_NAME_TAKEN: There is already a place with that name here.
errors.JOURNEY_NODE_TENANT_CAP_EXCEEDED: This organization has reached its limit of 500 places. Delete one to make room.
errors.JOURNEY_NOT_FOUND: That journey no longer exists, or you no longer have access to it.
errors.JOURNEY_OWNER_OUTSIDE_SCOPE: That location isn’t this location or one beneath it.
errors.JOURNEY_RADIUS_OUT_OF_RANGE: The radius must be between 10 m and 50 km.
errors.JOURNEY_ROUTE_IMMUTABLE: A journey’s route can’t be changed once it is saved. Duplicate it as a new journey to change the route.
errors.JOURNEY_SCOPE_NOT_FOUND: That location no longer exists, or you no longer have access to it.
errors.JOURNEY_TENANT_CAP_EXCEEDED: This organization has reached its limit of 100 journeys (disabled ones count). Delete one to make room.
errors.JOURNEY_ZONE_NOT_SUPPORTED: A zone can’t be a place yet. Use its floor or building instead.

list.deleteConsequence: Its assignments, every run it recorded and its analytics are deleted with it. To keep the history, disable it instead.
list.emptyBody: A journey is a route assets are expected to travel through your places. Create one, assign it, and see where the time goes.
list.emptyNoPlaces: A journey is a route assets are expected to travel through places that matter, like a loading dock and a wash bay. Create those places first.
list.noAccessBody: You need journey access at this location to see its journeys.
list.noOwnerBody: Journeys belong to a company, building or floor. Pick one to see its journeys.

node.untrackedBody: Circle places are saved but not followed yet, so a journey that stops at one won’t record runs.

nodeForm.name: Name
nodeForm.noZones: Zones aren’t offered: positions are not resolved to zones yet. Use the floor instead.
nodeForm.subtitle: A place journeys stop at, shared by every journey here.

nodes.deleteConsequence: A place can only be deleted while no journey stops at it.
nodes.empty: No places here yet. Add the places your assets travel between.
nodes.inUseDelete: These journeys stop here, disabled ones included. Delete them first, or keep the place.
nodes.inUseEdit: Journeys stop here, so only the name and description can change. Runs along them were recorded against this place. To move it, create a new place and a new journey over it.
nodes.subtitle: The places journeys here stop at. Define each once; every journey here can use it.
nodes.title: Places

route.duplicateToChange: Duplicate it to change the route.

route.immutableShort: A route and its timings never change once saved, so every run can be compared with every other.

route.timeHint: Average time at each stop and on each leg. The darker, the bigger its share of a run.
